contributions.basis: cover-line1 (over-$50 subset) + cover-line2 (sub-$50 subset), both in the LAST-REPORT column
contributions.detail: ** THIS FILER ITEMISED HIS SUB-$50 DONORS ON FORM A, so the sub-$50 trap has to be read the other way round here and the row set decomposes CLEANLY. ** Three rows: one of 4,000.00, which is EXACTLY the cover's line-1 (over $50) figure, and two of 25.00 each, which aggregate to EXACTLY 50.00, the cover's line-2 (aggregate of $50.00 or less) figure. So the over-$50 subset scores exact against line 1 as the addendum requires (4,000.00 = 4,000.00), and the remaining two rows are provably the small-donor aggregate rather than an unexplained excess. Total of rows emitted 4,050.00. The Gen-1 Carr form prints NO schedule total, so schedule_total is null - not zero - and the cover is the only anchor. ** COLUMN ANOMALY: the filer entered every figure in the 'TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT' column and left THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE entirely blank on all four lines. ** This is a mis-columned cover, not a prior-period carry-forward: the balance line is a slashed zero, there is no earlier filing, and the ledger dates (1/7/20 to 2/18/20) sit inside the span this 4/20/2020 report covers. Scope recorded as cumulative on that basis, with the period and cumulative scopes coinciding on a first report.

expenditures.detail: ** DELTA of +0.40, and the cause is traceable on the page. ** Twenty live rows sum to 4,050.40; the cover's only expenditure figure is 4,050.00. Both are retained verbatim and NEITHER was recomputed. Trace: the cover's 4,050.00 is EXACTLY line 1 + line 2 (4,000.00 + 50.00 = total contributions), and the balance line is a slashed zero - so the filer appears to have set total expenses equal to total contributions to drive the balance to zero, rather than adding Form B. His own ledger is 0.40 higher. A contributing input is Form B line 18 (Jackie Cooley, 'DONATION REIMBURSEMENT'), which reads 26.00 at 1200 dpi although the matching Form A contribution is 25.00. The 21st ruled row - '3-12-20 / WCRW - VOIDED / DEBATE BOOTH / $100.00', struck through end to end by the filer with the word VOIDED written in the payee cell - is EXCLUDED as a voided entry, and the arithmetic supports that exclusion: excluding it leaves a 0.40 residual, including it would leave 100.40. The Gen-1 Carr form prints no schedule total, so the cover line is the only anchor and there was no page subtotal to arbitrate the 0.40. Per contract every row of this side carries needs_review 1.

gates.page_subtotal: NEITHER schedule prints a total - both are Gen-1 Carr sheets ending in the '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper...)' note - so no page-subtotal gate exists on this filing and the cover's own lines are the only anchors. Gated against the cover: p2 rows 4,050.00 decompose exactly into cover line 1 (4,000.00) + cover line 2 (50.00); p3 rows 4,050.40 against cover line 3 4,050.00, a +0.40 delta retained verbatim.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py is not an oracle on Gen-1 ruled sheets, so an independent ink projection was run over the amount column at 200 dpi. p2 returns exactly 3 substantial ink bands between the header rule and the trailing blank rules -> 3 rows emitted. p3 returns exactly 21 substantial ink bands (the thin 0.18-pct bands are printed rules) -> 21 inked ledger rows, of which 20 are live and the 11th is the struck-out VOIDED row, giving the 20 rows emitted. The band list also placed the voided row independently at 31.45 pct, matching where it is seen on the page.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: the row-1 amount box renders '4,000.00' and the row-3 box '$25.00'; the control one row-pitch below row 3 renders EMPTY. p3: the row-1 box renders '$500.00' and the row-20 box (grid band 21) renders '$8.31'; the control one pitch below renders EMPTY. The emitted expenditure line numbers are mapped to grid bands explicitly, skipping band 11 (the voided row), so no row index is shifted by the exclusion.
gates.balance_chain: The cover's line-4 balance is a slashed-zero glyph = 0 (in the LAST-REPORT column, like everything else on this cover; the other two columns are blank). It does NOT close against the filer's own figures as a simple subtraction of what he wrote: 4,000.00 + 50.00 - 4,050.00 = 0 closes only because he set expenses equal to contributions; against his ACTUAL ledger, 4,050.00 - 4,050.40 = -0.40. Reported, not corrected. No earlier filing exists in this cycle for a cross-filing chain, and the LAST/THIS/CUMULATIVE structure is unusable here because of the column anomaly.

escalation_note: Form B rendered in four 500 dpi bands and its amount column re-read in two 600 dpi strips (an independent second read of all 21 amounts); nine 1200 dpi cell crops - Form B rows 2, 3, 5, 6 (date, with -normalize), 6 (amount), 18, 19, 20, 21 and Form A row 3's date; cover money block at 400 dpi; six 600 dpi geometry-proof crops.
notes: Generation-1 Carr Printing 5-5-PG form (cover cites Utah Code 17-16-6.5), hand-printed. PDF is 3 pages - the statute page 4 the form refers to is absent from this scan; a scan property, not a data gap. ** THE COVER'S 'Name of Office' LINE IS BLANK. ** The chunk file / index.csv says 'Recorder', but the form states no office at all (Office District is blank too); Political Party reads 'Republican'. The filing is not out of scope - it is addressed 'TO KIM HAFEN, County Clerk' on the county form - but the office attribution comes from outside the document and a human should know that. Candidate 'Johnathan Mark Liddle' agrees with the chunk file. Signed 4/20/20, RECEIVED stamp APR 20 2020. ** The portal file name also embeds 'June 23 2020', which matches no date on the form (that is the election date, not the report date). ** The candidate's street address, city, ZIP and two phone numbers are printed in the clear on the cover and were discarded at read time; so were every donor street line and ZIP on Form A, including a struck-out address on line 3. Form B carries no in-kind column and no purpose cell bears an in-kind label, so no row is marked in-kind. Form B's rows are NOT in date order (a 3-9-20 row follows a 3-13-20 row); printed order is preserved. Candidate-in-this-chunk cross-check: none of the other six documents is this report.
